definitions.short: a (sudden) alarm (properly, the object feared, by implication, the feeling)
definitions.full: H6343. pachad I. מַּ֫חַד 49 noun masculine 1Sam 11:7 dread ; — ׳פ absolute Gen 31:42 +, construct 1Sam 11:7 +, suffix מַּחְדְּךָ Deut 2:25 ; Psa 119:120 , מַּחְדּוֺ Job 13:11 ; 1Chr 14:17 , etc.; plural מְּחָדִים Job 15:21 : — 1 dread , ׳י׳פ , i.e. before ׳י , often (not always) terrifying, unfitting for action, Isa 2:10 , 19 , 21 ; 1Sam 11:7 ; 2Chr 14:13 ; 17:10 , so ׳פ אֱהִֹים 20:29 , with suffix Job 13:11 ; Psa 119:120 trembleth for dread of thee ; with Genitive object Israel, Deut 2:25 (|| יִרְאָה ), 11:25 (|| מוֺרָא ), Psa 105:38 ; Est 8:17 ; 9:2 , ׳פ אוֺיֵב Psa 64:2 , of individual 1Chr 14:17 ; Est 9:3 ; with Genitive object of thing Prov 1:33 ; absolute, in General, Exod 15:16 (song; || אֵימָ֫תָה ), Job 4:14 (|| רְעָדָה ), Jer 30:5 (|| חֲרָדָה קוֺל ) +; as accusative of congnate meaning with verb with מָּחַד Psa 14:5 + (see מָּחַד ); c. Genitive subject Prov 1:26-27 , (both || אֵיד ) Deut 28:67 . 2 = object of dread Psa 31:12 ; 36:2 , ׳פ אֵלַי Job 31:23 ; מָּחַדְתִּי מַּחַד 3:25 ; הַמַּחַד מִקּוֺל Isa 24:18 sound of the disaster , for הַמּ ׳מִמְּנֵי of original Jer 48:44 , but מְּחָדִים קוֺל Job 15:21 = a sound of terrors; מִּתְאֹם ׳פ 22:10 ; Prov 3:25 . 3 as designation of deity ׳פ יִצְחָק Gen 31:42 (|| אַבְרָהָם אֱהֵֹי ), so 31:53 (|| id. ; both E).
